title: [suggestion] Implement a sort of "command buffer" for omnipod Eros pumps in the app
symptom: When a bolus is being administered, other pump interactions are disabled, and in open loop mode a new basal suggestion cannot be applied during an active bolus. Also, after confirming a bolus and closing the app, the bolus progress dialog no longer appears.
cause: The thread explains that the limitation is due to pump firmware and that AAPS already has a CommandQueue for background commands, but the bolus progress dialog is intentionally shown because most pumps do not support issuing another command during a bolus.
fix: No fix was needed; the maintainer explained that the CommandQueue already exists for background commands and that the bolus progress dialog is intentional. The user acknowledged the explanation and closed the issue.
evidence_quote: This already exists. It's called `CommandQueue` and it does work for background commands (setting of profile, TBR, SMB etc). Having a dialog for bolus progress is our decision because most pumps support displaying progress and during bolus you cannot issue another command to the pump anyway.
